programmes.d: Blaze and the Banshee warriors prepare to attack the Alliance for kidnapping Queen Mab...

The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

As the girls continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, Nate bullies Lewis. Despite the girls’ attempts to keep Charlotte under control, she uses her powers on Nate and almost exposes them all.

Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.
Masamune studies hard and manages to beat Chaoxin in the first battle of the Championships.
Tsubasa suffers a stunning defeat to the arrogant Chiyun.
A fierce battle takes place between Gingka and Dashan.
The team travels abroad and encounters Julian Konzern battling Desert Blaze single-handedly.
Gingka and the team meet the Russian players and battle them on the way to Russia, not knowing they make up the Russian team.
Gingka's team battles the Russian team; Masamune is lost in the countryside.
It’s time for Sabrina’s wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn’t want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically.
When Harvey can’t make the wrestling team, Sabrina uses Dragon Spray to help him.
Gem and Sabrina are teamed up to work on a book report.
Sabrina’s baseball team is on a major losing streak. And Gem is there to point it out.
When it seems like Hilda isn’t going to pass a test for her mortal driver’s license, Sabrina conjures up a cute driving instructor to help & inspire her.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: I was a Teenage Vampire
programmes.d: The Vampires are back, and this time Scarlet has unearthed her evil master Medlock, the Lord of the Vampires.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Halloween of Horror
programmes.d: Veronica's annual Halloween bash turns into chaos when the resurrected Lord of the Vampires crashes the party.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Archie's Date with Fate
programmes.d: When a thief steals a time travel device from Dilton's lab, Archie finds himself trapped in a time loop where he relives the same horrible day over and over again, always ending with the same disastrous date with Veronica.

Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.

Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start…
Rene Auberjonois plays the Donald, a PR wiz who puts Eerie into a shopping spree at World O' Stuff.
After finding a TV script in his mailbox, Marshall finds himself in Hollywood, his family out of character and his name 'Omri' - who's destined to die in the script.
On a family picnic, brothers Rick and Teddy spend their time keeping three year-old sister Becky out of trouble, and waging war on a hill of ants with squirt guns and magnifying glasses.
Strict teacher Felix Purdy has always been tough on his students, particularly on introverted dreamer Daryl Kregman.
Young Randy is reluctant to accompany his Uncle Ned on a fishing trip / Delinquents Eddie and Herman have a bad habit of stealing parts for their hot rod from cars on the street.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.
After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.
Scott visits his cousin, Todd, but the two have nothing in common. As Scott tries to help Todd come out of his shell, he realizes that he and his cousin are much more alike than he initially thought.
Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.
Evil monsters from a virtual reality game break out and materialize in Riverdale!
Veronica doesn't think that Archie dotes on her enough, so she visits a witch woman who gives her a magic potion.

'Pinkazuma's Revenge': Don Rosaro Pantero encounters Conquistadors, Aztecs and an uncooperative Parrot in the New World. 'Pinky Down Under': Australian bush guide Pinky is hired by two city slickers who try to poach the rare pygmy plaid kangaroo.

'Pinkadoon': Taxi driver Pinky gets trapped in an Arabian Nights city which magically appears for only one hour every hundred years. 'A Camp-Pink We Will Go': Working as a park ranger, the Panther tries to keep peace and quiet at Hand Rock Park.
Grounder accidentally puts a "genius chip"in his head and it makes him so smart that he easily captures Sonic and even takes over Robotnik's operations.
When Scratch and Grounder zap Sonic with Robotnik's new freeze ray, Tails uses intellect and disguises to foil the two henchmen and ensure Sonic's safety.
Inspector Gadget foils the evil plans of Waldo, an M.A.D. agent, who is trying to steal Greenfinger's secret formula that enlarges plants.
Inspector Gadget destroys M.A.D.'s plans for a western base in a Wild West Tourist Town.

Mr. Bean is in a trance – barks like a dog and starts to dance. Mr. Bean goes to the theatre to see a performance by a celebrated hypnotist, Dr. Daze. Bean is super keen to come up on stage and be part of the show. But, after being hypnotized.

Mr. Bean builds a car washing machine that attracts all manner of customers. Mr. Bean's car is filthy, so he gives it a good wash. His sparklingly clean car attracts the attention of other drivers, who offer to pay Mr. Bean to wash their cars too.

Mr. Bean is wracked with guilt after he chases Scrapper and ends up with a flattened cat. Mr. Bean chases Scrapper around Mrs. Wicket’s flat but her sideboard tumbles over, and when Bean sees a bit of fur poking out from under it.
Mr. Bean plays gooseberry when Mrs. Wicket falls in love with a man Mr. Bean doesn’t trust. Mr. Bean helps Mrs. Wicket collect up all her money together after she witnesses a robbery.

Mr. Bean takes trick or treating to the next level in a war with his next-door neighbours! Mr. Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget.

Rip & Co. wing to Japan to investigate reports of a live Oni, the Japanese Demon. They discover that the Oni report is a cover-up for something even more fantastic: the discovery of the magical Daruma Dolls.
While diving around an old shipwreck, Rip and Samantha have their yacht stolen on the high seas by the modern pirates.
